notes: SwarmCoreToken mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 CORE with 18 decimals once to msg.sender in its no-argument constructor. Transfers move the exact requested amount. The token has no owner, further minting, transfer fees, burning, pause or blacklist. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs CORE with IMD at a 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
